## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI/UX improvement
- [ ] API or database change
- [ ] AI/ML pipeline change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Deployment or infrastructure

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run`
- [ ] `pytest ai-service/tests -q` when Python code changed
- [ ] Responsive layout checked when UI changed
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Responsible AI and security

- [ ] No secrets or personal data are included
- [ ] Demo metrics are not presented as measured results
- [ ] Dataset/model claims include evidence and evaluation details
- [ ] Privacy and abuse risks were considered

## Screenshots or logs

Add screenshots for visual changes or sanitized logs for runtime changes.
